jobs.title: SALES ASSOCIATE (80%) M/W
jobs.description: As a Sales Associate, your role is to create exceptional client experiences while actively contributing to the commercial success of the boutique. ​ Welcome and advise a local and international clientele with professionalism and authenticity. Deliver a memorable luxury experience aligned with Fusalp's standards and values. Understand client needs and recommend products that best suit their lifestyle and expectations. Contribute to achieving and exceeding sales targets and boutique KPIs. Build long-term customer relationships through outstanding service and clienteling. Actively contribute to the development of the client database. Contribute to the visual merchandising and presentation of the boutique. Support stock management, deliveries, inventories. Contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment. What Will Help You Succeed : You have at least 5 years of sucess experience in luxury retail, premium retail, hospitality or another environment where customer experience is key. You enjoy selling and are motivated by achieving ambitious targets. You understand what excellent service looks like and naturally build trust with clients. You are reliable, proactive and willing to support the team wherever needed. You speak English (minimum B2). German is highly appreciated; French or Spanish are a plus. What We Offer : A permanent part-time contract (80%). The opportunity to join an international luxury House with strong growth ambitions. A clear development path towards an Assistant Store Manager position. Continuous training on products, client experience and leadership. An healthy entrepreneurial environment where performance, initiative and commitment are recognized and rewarded. If you are passionate about luxury, customer experience and commercial success, and if you are looking for more than a sales role, a genuine career opportunity within a growing House, we would love to hear from you.
